review.decision: Retain an explicitly opened Live viewer across same-session redraws
review.notes: Use a synthetic browser fixture and mounted mobile components. Check rendered controls, content and reader choices. No user session or device input.

cases.description: Focused and tiled Live stay open through transcript and status refreshes
cases.setup: Open and resize Live on a working pane, then scroll away from the tail.
cases.action: Append a turn, refresh observation metadata, change status, close while idle, resume work and switch session.
cases.expected: The open panel and frozen position survive same-session refreshes. Closing is sticky. A new identity starts fresh. The label reflects the current status.

cases.description: Mobile Chat retains an open Live overlay while the current pane waits or becomes idle
cases.setup: Mount a working conversation and open the overlay.
cases.action: Update transcript and status; resize, close, resume work and switch panes.
cases.expected: An open overlay remains visible at the chosen height and reports the current status. Closing during idle hides the strip, and returning to work respects that choice.
